body.statement: For every \((Q,P)\in\mathcal M_{L,\eta}\), the shared bridge satisfies \(A_Pg=b_P\) and the causal target satisfies \(\theta=R_0g\). Consequently, \(H(P)\ne\varnothing\).
body.justification: This is the observable reduction that separates bridge algebra from the harder causal necessity direction.
body.gap: Su et al. derive the two-trial bridge formula; the stacked multigraph operator and target map are not stated there.
body.consumer: It gives network analysts a finite linear system whose solutions encode every causally admissible root contrast.
